person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: what actually happens at a manganese dioxide cathode in a mild-acidic aqueous zinc cell - which phase is present, which ion moves, and where the lost capacity goes
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: whether the competing published mechanisms for Zn insertion in MnO2 polymorphs are different reactions or one reaction seen at different points, and whether the resulting cell can be made to cycle
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: one common electrode mechanism for alpha, beta and gamma MnO2 - an irreversible tunnel-to-layered conversion to Zn-buserite on first discharge followed by reversible Zn2+ (de)intercalation - plus a triflate electrolyte with a Mn2+ additive giving 94% retention over 2000 cycles
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanism
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a cathode material that changes identity during its own first discharge, so that its measured properties before and after describe different substances
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: ex-situ XRD at ten marked states across two cycles, TEM/HRTEM/ABF-STEM, EDS, XPS, TGA, synchrotron Mn K-edge XANES and EXAFS, ICP-AES on the electrolyte, three-electrode voltammetry and EIS, across four electrolyte formulations
span.term: ex-situ XRD at ten marked states across two cycles, TEM/HRTEM/ABF-STEM, EDS, XPS, TGA, synchrotron Mn K-edge XANES and EXAFS, ICP-AES on the electrolyte, three-electrode voltammetry and EIS, across four electrolyte formulations
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Zn2+ and water co-insert into the pyrolusite framework, manganese dissolves away leaving vacancies, and the tunnel structure distorts into stacked layers with water between them; every subsequent cycle is intercalation into that layered product, so the material's own first discharge is the synthesis of the working electrode
span.term: a host that becomes a different host on first use
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Mn3+ in the solid disproportionates into Mn4+ that stays and Mn2+ that leaves; pre-loading the electrolyte with Mn2+ moves the equilibrium so that less leaves, which is why an additive that is not a reactant improves retention
span.term: a dissolution equilibrium bought with a sacrificial solute
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: charging in Mn2+-containing electrolyte electrodeposits a porous amorphous MnOx nanosheet film on the cathode; being porous it does not impede mass diffusion, and it holds the electrode together - the EIS shows a new interface resistance of 6 ohm appearing while charge transfer falls from 350 to 25
span.term: a deposit that protects rather than blocks
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: triflate carries one charge against sulfate's two and is larger, so fewer water molecules surround each Zn2+; the ion moves and transfers charge more easily, which the paper offers as why the same cation in two salts gives 275 against 120 mAh g-1
span.term: a bulky anion thinning the solvation shell
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the exact structural motif of the Zn-buserite phase the whole mechanism rests on is not determined
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the tunnel-to-layer conversion is irreversible, and together with Mn dissolution and electrode pulverization it is the source of the capacity fade the additive only mitigates
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: nanorods expand and exfoliate over cycling, which the authors expect to cost capacity
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the triflate salt is more expensive than the sulfate or hydroxide it replaces, and the authors say so rather than leaving it to a reader
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the deposited MnOx layer contributes about 2.4% of the delivered capacity itself, so the reported cathode capacity is not purely the cathode's
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the mechanism literature it corrects is genuinely contradictory - spinel, layered, birnessite and a conversion reaction have all been proposed for the same electrode
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: buserite, a layered manganese oxide known as a mineral, used as the structural model for a discharge product in a battery electrode
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: synchrotron X-ray absorption spectroscopy, carried from structural physics into reading the oxidation state and local coordination of a cycled electrode
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the discharged electrode rinsed with water before EDS and XPS, with sulfur and fluorine checked for as the signature of residual electrolyte salt
span.note: eliminates: precipitated electrolyte on the surface being read as part of the discharge product - S and F absent means the Zn and Mn signal is the electrode's · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the rinsed discharged XRD pattern compared against every species previously reported for this electrode - MnOOH, spinel ZnMn2O4, birnessite, tunnelled and layered Zn-Mn oxides - and then Rietveld refined
span.note: eliminates: the new phase being one of the published ones under another name; the comparison is to the named alternatives, not to nothing · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: alpha-MnO2 and gamma-MnO2 taken through the identical XRD and XAS analysis, not only the beta polymorph the argument is built on
span.note: eliminates: the mechanism being a peculiarity of one polymorph - the claim is that the three converge, and it is tested on the three · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: thermal gravimetric analysis of the discharged phase, to test whether the water the structural model requires between the layers is actually there
span.note: eliminates: the layered assignment resting on diffraction alone - the model predicts interlayer water and a mass-loss measurement can refute it · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: ICP-AES on the electrolyte at successive states of discharge, after the measured Mn valence disagreed with the value the delivered capacity predicts
span.note: eliminates: the postulated disproportionation staying a postulate - the manganese that left the electrode is counted where it went rather than inferred from where it is not · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: four electrolytes compared on the same cell chemistry - 45 wt% KOH, 3 M ZnSO4, 3 M Zn(CF3SO3)2, and the same with 0.1 M Mn(CF3SO3)2 added
span.note: eliminates: the cathode alone as the explanation of the cycling behaviour, and alkaline against mild-acidic as an untested assumption · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the additive chosen as Mn(CF3SO3)2 rather than MnSO4, and then the cross combinations ZnSO4+MnSO4 and Zn(CF3SO3)2+MnSO4 also run
span.note: eliminates: the anion as a hidden variable in the additive experiment - varying the cation while the anion changes too would confound the two · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: electrolyte concentration varied from 1 M to 3 M with everything else held
span.note: eliminates: concentration being confounded with the choice of salt · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: three-electrode voltammetry across the working potential window, against the Nernst estimate for forming MnO2 and Mn2O3 from the additive
span.note: eliminates: the added Mn2+ being reduced and plated during operation - the measurement shows it is not, within the window actually used · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the capacity contributed by the deposited MnOx layer itself measured separately
span.note: eliminates: the protective deposit being an unacknowledged second active material - it is one, at 2.4%, and the number is given · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: EIS on dismantled cathodes after ten cycles, with and without the additive, fitted to the same equivalent circuit
span.note: eliminates: the additive's benefit being attributed to chemistry when it is partly interfacial - the fit separates series, interface, charge-transfer and diffusion terms and only some of them move · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: post-mortem examination of the zinc anode in all three electrolytes, plus EDS for manganese on the anode surface
span.note: eliminates: the cathode being credited with a cell-level improvement that belongs to the anode, and manganese plating on the zinc as a hidden sink · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: commercial micrometre-sized beta-MnO2 powder run in the same electrolyte alongside the hydrothermally grown nanorods
span.note: eliminates: the nanorod morphology as the source of the result - a bulk commercial powder with no special preparation also cycles · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
